The build passes and the fix works as intended. Note the route marker changed: - `/product` is now `◐ (Partial Prerender)` — **prerendered as static HTML with dynamic server-streamed content**. Previously the whole page was dynamic and blocked on `getInventory()`. Now the static shell (including the `

Premium Widget

` title) is prerendered and served instantly, while the inventory streams in behind the Suspense boundary. The `unstable_instant = true` validation passed during the build, confirming navigation to this page is instant. ## What I changed `app/product/page.tsx`: - Made the page component **synchronous** — it no longer `await`s at the top level, which was what blocked the entire render (title included). - Kept the static title `

Premium Widget

` in the page body so it's part of the prerendered static shell and paints immediately on navigation. - Moved the dynamic `getInventory()` call (which forces dynamic rendering via `connection()`) down into a child `Inventory` component wrapped in ``, so only the stock/price stream in. - Added `export const unstable_instant = true` so Next.js validates this route navigates instantly and catches future regressions. The title now appears immediately on navigation from Home; the in-stock count and price stream in a moment later behind a "Checking availability..." fallback.
